question: Wound healing, false statement (order of cell arrival)

options.text: The most predominant cell at day 3-4 after a wound is macrophages
The most predominant cell in the first 24 hours of the wound is PMN
The order of cell arrival in wound is macrophages, platelets, PMNS, fibroblasts

correct_text: The order of cell arrival in wound is macrophages, platelets, PMNS, fibroblasts
